runtime:sandbox-read-only.en: Current DSH file policy: read-only. Any available operation enforced by the DSH file sandbox cannot modify files in the standing mode. Do not refuse a required modification from this policy alone: try an available tool normally and follow any denial and escalation guidance it returns.
runtime:sandbox-read-only.zh: 当前 DSH 文件策略：read-only。DSH 文件沙箱所约束的可用操作无法在常驻模式下修改文件。不要仅凭这一策略就拒绝必需的修改：照常尝试可用的工具，并遵循其返回的任何拒绝与提权指引。

runtime:sandbox-danger-full-access.en: Current DSH file policy: danger-full-access. The DSH file sandbox does not restrict file modifications by available operations.
runtime:sandbox-danger-full-access.zh: 当前 DSH 文件策略：danger-full-access。DSH 文件沙箱不会限制可用操作对文件的修改。

runtime:approval-never.en: Approval prompts are disabled in this session: actions that require approval are rejected automatically — do not request sandbox escalation (do not set `sandbox_permissions`).
runtime:approval-never.zh: 本会话已禁用审批提示：需要审批的操作会被自动拒绝——不要请求沙箱提权（不要设置 `sandbox_permissions`）。

runtime:skill-catalog-changed.en: The available skill catalog changed. This complete catalog replaces every earlier available-skills list in this session:
runtime:skill-catalog-changed.zh: 可用的技能清单已变更。本完整清单会取代本会话中更早的所有可用技能列表：

runtime:skill-catalog-empty.en: No skills are currently available through the `skill` tool. Do not use names from earlier skill catalogs.
runtime:skill-catalog-empty.zh: 当前没有可通过 `skill` 工具使用的技能。不要使用更早技能清单中的名称。

runtime:skill-catalog-replacement.en: Use only names in this replacement catalog. If the user names a listed skill, or the task clearly matches its description, call the `skill` tool with the exact name before acting.
runtime:skill-catalog-replacement.zh: 只使用本次替换清单中的名称。如果用户点名了清单中的技能，或任务明显符合某个技能的描述，先在行动前用精确名称调用 `skill` 工具。

runtime:skill-catalog-direct.en: A user may still invoke a skill directly; its <skill_content> block then appears in this conversation. Follow it, and do not call the `skill` tool for it.
runtime:skill-catalog-direct.zh: 用户也可能直接调用某个技能；此时其 <skill_content> 内容块会出现在本对话中。请遵循它，不要为它调用 `skill` 工具。
